data.text: [00:00]CD1 Track 4
J = Jerry, W = Woman
[00:03.8]Yes … The article is about his typical day – it’s quite surprising actually!
[00:08.6]Really? Why’s that?

[00:10.6]Well, his race days are very busy and stressful … and he works very hard. `[00:16.7]You know, he gets up early – at about six or seven o’clock and prepares for the race in the morning. `[00:23]Then he races in the afternoon.
[00:25.8]Yes, I’m sure it’s really busy … What’s surprising, then?

[00:31]Well, most sports people work really hard every day, and spend all their time training … but Rossi’s ‘normal’ days – when he doesn’t go to a race – are very relaxing. `[00:43]He has quite a lazy lifestyle actually! He says that his normal life is like being on holiday!
[00:50.4]What does he do?
[00:51.8]Well, he gets up late … He says he isn’t a morning person.
[00:55.8]What time does he get up?
[00:57.7]He gets up at eleven o’clock …
[01:00]Eleven o’clock!
[01:01.6]Yes, and he’s always quiet in the mornings. `[01:04.3]He doesn’t talk to his family for the first hour!
[01:07]Oh, same as me! I don’t chat to anyone in the morning. `[01:12]Sorry, anyway, what about Rossi’s training? Does he go to the gym or something?
[01:18.1]Yes, he needs to stay fit for his racing, so he goes to the gym between twelve and two in the afternoon.
[01:24.9]Really? Only two hours in the gym.
[01:28.7]Mmm … it’s not much, is it? I think it’s quite an unusual routine for a top sportsperson.
[01:35]Yeah, I sometimes go to the gym for two or three hours.
[01:39.3]Do you?! Really? How often do you go to the gym?
[01:43]Well, I go about once a week, I suppose!
[01:46.8]No, you don’t! You go about twice a year!!
[01:50.7]Oh, ok … . `[01:53]Anyway, back to Rossi … what does he do for the rest of the day?
[01:59]Umm … it says that in the afternoon, he often listens to music and plays computer games. `[02:05.7]And he sometimes watches a film.
[02:07.9]What about the evening? Does he go out late?

[02:10.9]Yes, he does!! He hardly ever goes to bed early. `[02:15]His evenings are fun and he usually has a plan to go out with friends. `[02:19.2]He likes going out to parties and clubs. `[02:22]He’s a real party animal apparently … He usually goes to bed about three or four in the morning!!
[02:28]That’s late!!
[02:29.6]Yes, he says he’s got a lot of energy after 2:00 a.m.
[02:33.8]What about before a race day? What time does he go to bed then?
[02:38]Before race days, too … he goes to bed at two or three in the morning … and then he usually wins the race!!
[02:45.7]Wow! Rossi’s life is very exciting! My life is really boring! I’d like to have his lifestyle …
[02:55]Me too.
